question.prompt: In \(\triangle ABC\), \(D\) and \(E\) are the midpoints of \(AB\) and \(AC\), respectively. If \(BC=10\), how long is \(DE\)? (Enter only the length of \(DE\).)

solutions.explanation: \(DE\) is a midsegment, so \(DE\parallel BC\) and \(DE=BC/2=5\).
solutions.title: Triangle midsegment theorem
